module origen_196418(
    input reset,
    input in_en,
    input clk,
    input start1,
    input [7:0] part_msg1,
    input load1,
    output [127:0] plaintext,
    output [127:0] key,
    output done
);

reg [7:0] part_msg;
reg [255:0] tmp_msg;
reg [255:0] reg_msg;
reg pulse_start;
reg load_en;
reg done_en;
reg [7:0] adrs;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        pulse_start <= 1'b0;
        load_en <= 1'b0;
        adrs <= 8'd0;
        done_en <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
        if (in_en) begin
            pulse_start <= start1;
            load_en <= load1;
            if (load_en) begin
                part_msg <= part_msg1;
                tmp_msg <= {tmp_msg[247:0], part_msg};
                adrs <= adrs + 8'd1;
            end
            if (adrs == 8'd31) begin
                reg_msg <= tmp_msg;
                done_en <= 1'b1;
            end
            else begin
                done_en <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
end

assign plaintext = reg_msg[255:128];
assign key = reg_msg[127:0];
assign done = done_en;

endmodule
